messages:
Tess H: Heads-up — invoice INV-2026-411 for OrionCo's private deployment shows PLATFORM_FEE as 12 months. We agreed a 3-month migration overlap credit during onboarding, so the bill should be for 9 months. Can we hold payment and issue a credit memo?
Leo P: When was the overlapping period documented? I remember a migration concession but not sure if it was captured in billing flags.
Nikhil S: Sales recorded the concession in the SOW signed 2025-11-20. Account notes show '3mo migration overlap credit'. Exported billing job missed the addendum tag. Customer also requested support downgrade from Premier to Standard effective on renewal.
BillingBot: Invoice INV-2026-411 generated (total: $160,000). Line items:
- PLATFORM_FEE: $144,000 (12mo)
- SUPPORT_PREMIER: $16,000
Link: https://invoices.redwood.ai/INV-2026-411
Tess H: Proposed adjustment: credit PLATFORM_FEE by 3 months (-$36,000), replace SUPPORT_PREMIER with SUPPORT_STANDARD on reissued invoice. Will need Legal + RevOps sign-off before reissue.
Leo P: I'll attach the signed SOW and the migration email thread now. If Sales approved the concession, finance can create a credit memo.
Priya D: I see the SOW. It references a 'migration credit' but doesn't specify dollars. We need Sales confirmation of the monthly platform rate used for the calc.
Nikhil S: Platform monthly agreed = $12,000. 3 months = $36,000. Support Standard rate is $9,000 annually, so we should change that line and adjust totals.
LegalBot: I reviewed the SOW snippet — 'migration credit' is valid authorization for issuing a credit as long as Sales confirms the numeric calculation. No exec sign-off required.
BillingBot: Invoice INV-2026-411 status set to: hold: credit_review. Created credit request CR-421.
Tess H: Next steps I'll take: 1) Draft credit memo CR-421 (-$36,000), 2) Void original invoice and reissue adjusted invoice with PLATFORM_FEE (9mo) and SUPPORT_STANDARD, 3) Notify customer and CS to prevent unintended collections. Approvals: RevOps ack + Legal already checked.
Leo P: RevOps acknowledged in thread — good to proceed. I'll notify the customer that billing is paused while we reissue.
Priya D: I'll update the support SKU in billing system once the reissued invoice is ready.\nTess H: Thanks team — please add any objections now, otherwise finance will push the credit and new invoice by EOD. :white_check_mark:
